title: fraxinus angustifolia f. monophylla
intro: Fraxinus angustifolia f. monophylla, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Ash or Manzanita Ash, is a plant species in the olive family (Oleaceae) that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and alleviating pain. The health benefits of Fraxinus angustifolia f. monophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative and analgesic effects, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and pain management.
